notes: GAAP city report with governmental activities only (utilities not in this report), so business_type is null, as in FY2023. Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); proceeds from long-term debt 1,625,000 is debt_proceeds and sale of capital assets 14,761 is other_financing (both printed under Other Financing Sources). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1; FY2022 prints a single 'Capital assets, net' line). ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents + restricted cash + cash at County Treasurer from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p3), as in FY2023; beginning cash not printed. Detail: General Fund revenues from its GAAP schedule (p7) and spending from the departmental Schedule of Expenditures (pp8-12; total 4,570,395); the General Fund budget-basis schedule (p5) is not recorded to avoid double counting; GF transfers gross from the fund statement (p4) since p7 prints only the net. Special Projects Fund from its budget-basis schedule (p6; budget-basis actuals differ from the GAAP fund statement, e.g. intergovernmental 572,898 vs 15,121, and it prints 'Receipt of due from other funds' 557,777). Other governmental funds per column from the combining statement (p13). Debt Service Fund has no schedule (not added). Read pages 1-13 of 13
